Think about something you repeat every day. Here’s how a connected process could take a few things off your plate.

The familiar routine

Check your inbox. Copy the details. Write a reply. Remember to follow up.

A more useful way

  1. ↳ Someone gets in touchA customer fills in your form.
  2. ✓ Details organizedThe enquiry goes into your business tools.
  3. ↗ Next step startedA reply is sent and a follow-up is scheduled.

The familiar routine

Trade messages about availability. Add a calendar entry. Send a reminder yourself.

A more useful way

  1. ↳ A time is chosenYour customer books an available slot.
  2. ✓ Calendars connectedThe appointment and details are saved.
  3. ↗ Reminder deliveredA confirmation and reminder go out on time.

The familiar routine

Open several tools. Download spreadsheets. Copy the numbers into another report.

A more useful way

  1. ↳ Your tools connectedBring the relevant business data together.
  2. ✓ A summary preparedOrganize the numbers you actually need.
  3. ↗ Report deliveredSend a scheduled update to your inbox.

Example workflows. We’ll design yours around your tools and the steps you want to keep in your hands.
